Nkotosrɛ mpaebɔ
1 # Kol 4.3 Deɛ ɛdi akyire no, anuanom, mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn, na Awurade asɛm nnya kwan nkɔ so, na wɔnhyɛ no animuonyam, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ wɔ mo hɔ nso. 2Na wɔnyi yɛn mfiri nnipa amumuyɛfoɔ ne abɔnefoɔ nsa mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ nnipa nyinaa na wɔwɔ gyidie. 3#1 Te 5.24 Ɔnokwafoɔ ne Awurade a ɔbɛhyɛ mo den na wahwɛ mo so ɔbɔnefoɔ no ho no. 4#2 Ko 7.16; Gal 5.10 Na yɛn ani da mo so Awurade mu, sɛ moyɛ na mobɛyɛ deɛ yɛhyɛ mo. 5Na Awurade mma monhunu Nyankopɔn dɔ ne Kristo boasetɔ no mu.
Adwuma pa
6 # Mat 18.17; Rom 16.17 Na anuanom, yɛhyɛ mo Awurade Yesu Kristo din mu, sɛ montwe mo ho mfiri onua biara a ɔnam basabasa na ɔnni atetesɛm a ɔnyaa no yɛn nkyɛn no soɔ no ho. 7#1 Te 1.6 Na mo ara monim sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mosua yɛn, ɛfiri sɛ yɛanyɛ yɛn ho basabasa wɔ mo mu, 8#1 Ko 4.12 nanso yɛanni obiara aduane kwa, na mmom yɛyɛɛ adwuma, mmɔdemmɔ ne ɔbrɛ mu, anadwo ne awia, na yɛanyɛ adesoa amma mo mu biara; 9#Mat 10.10; 1 Ko 4.16 ɛnyɛ sɛ yɛnni ho kwan na mmom yɛyɛɛ sɛ yɛde yɛn ho reyɛ nhwɛsoɔ ama mo na moasua yɛn. 10#Gye 3.19 Na yɛwɔ mo nkyɛn no nso, yɛhyɛɛ mo sɛ, sɛ obi mpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma a, mma ɔno nso nnidi.
11Na yɛte sɛ ebinom wɔ hɔ a wɔnenam basabasa wɔ mo mu, na wɔnyɛ adwuma, na mmom wɔyɛ terɛterɛ. 12#1 Te 4.11 Na wɔn a wɔte saa no, yɛhyɛ wɔn, tu wɔn fo, yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo mu, sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma komm mfa mpɛ wɔn anoduane.
13 # Gal 6.9 Na mo deɛ, anuanom, mommmrɛ papayɛ mu. 14#2 Te 3.6; 1 Ko 5.9; 5.11 Na sɛ obi antie yɛn asɛm a ɛwɔ nwoma yi mu a, monhyɛ no nso, mo ne no mmmɔ fekuo, na n’ani nwu; 15nanso mommmu no sɛ ɔtamfoɔ, na mmom monkasa nkyerɛ no sɛ onua.
16Na ɔno asomdwoeɛ Awurade no ara mma mo asomdwoeɛ daa, adeɛ nyinaa mu. Awurade ne mo nyinaa ntena.
Nkradie ne nhyira
17 # 1 Ko 16.21 Me Paulo nkyea a mede me ara me nsa metwerɛeɛ. Yei di adanseɛ wɔ me nwoma nyinaa mu sɛ ɔkwan a mefa so twerɛ nie. 18Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo nyinaa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Deɛ ɛdi akyire no, anuanom, mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn, na Awurade asɛm nnya kwan nkɔ so, na wɔnhyɛ no animuonyam, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ wɔ mo hɔ nso. Na wɔnyi yɛn mfiri nnipa amumuyɛfoɔ ne abɔnefoɔ nsa mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ nnipa nyinaa na wɔwɔ gyidie. Ɔnokwafoɔ ne Awurade a ɔbɛhyɛ mo den na wahwɛ mo so ɔbɔnefoɔ no ho no. Na yɛn ani da mo so Awurade mu, sɛ moyɛ na mobɛyɛ deɛ yɛhyɛ mo. Na Awurade mma monhunu Nyankopɔn dɔ ne Kristo boasetɔ no mu.

Na anuanom, yɛhyɛ mo Awurade Yesu Kristo din mu, sɛ montwe mo ho mfiri onua biara a ɔnam basabasa na ɔnni atetesɛm a ɔnyaa no yɛn nkyɛn no soɔ no ho. Na mo ara monim sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mosua yɛn, ɛfiri sɛ yɛanyɛ yɛn ho basabasa wɔ mo mu, nanso yɛanni obiara aduane kwa, na mmom yɛyɛɛ adwuma, mmɔdemmɔ ne ɔbrɛ mu, anadwo ne awia, na yɛanyɛ adesoa amma mo mu biara; ɛnyɛ sɛ yɛnni ho kwan na mmom yɛyɛɛ sɛ yɛde yɛn ho reyɛ nhwɛsoɔ ama mo na moasua yɛn. Na yɛwɔ mo nkyɛn no nso, yɛhyɛɛ mo sɛ, sɛ obi mpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma a, mma ɔno nso nnidi.
Na yɛte sɛ ebinom wɔ hɔ a wɔnenam basabasa wɔ mo mu, na wɔnyɛ adwuma, na mmom wɔyɛ terɛterɛ. Na wɔn a wɔte saa no, yɛhyɛ wɔn, tu wɔn fo, yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo mu, sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma komm mfa mpɛ wɔn anoduane.
Na mo deɛ, anuanom, mommmrɛ papayɛ mu. Na sɛ obi antie yɛn asɛm a ɛwɔ nwoma yi mu a, monhyɛ no nso, mo ne no mmmɔ fekuo, na n’ani nwu; nanso mommmu no sɛ ɔtamfoɔ, na mmom monkasa nkyerɛ no sɛ onua.
Na ɔno asomdwoeɛ Awurade no ara mma mo asomdwoeɛ daa, adeɛ nyinaa mu. Awurade ne mo nyinaa ntena.

Me Paulo nkyea a mede me ara me nsa metwerɛeɛ. Yei di adanseɛ wɔ me nwoma nyinaa mu sɛ ɔkwan a mefa so twerɛ nie. Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
